title: MFD verification code: metriplectic discrete-gradient model of dissipation-capped relaxation
description: Simulation and verification code, raw data (300 deterministic trials), and scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the article 'A Metriplectic Discrete-Gradient Model of Dissipation-Capped Relaxation: Monotone Integration, a Two-Regime Time Decomposition, and a Circulation-Induced Crossover' (submitted to the Journal of Statistical Physics).
